text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Announcement! The theme for the next 
Tracen Academy applicant brochure shall 
be— "The Strongest"!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The strongest horse girl possessing 
"Spirit, Technique, and Legs" shall grace 
the cover! Those confident in their might, 
assembleーー!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after Chairwoman Akikawa's sudden 
declaration, I heard a tournament was 
being held to decide the cover girl and 
went to check it out—

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!! I'm definitely the strongest 
one hereーー!!

text_block_list.name: Feisty Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya barkin' about, punk! It's obvious 
that I'm the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It seems quite a few more have gathered 
than I originally anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Feisty Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Tch! T-the demon's here...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...My, why have you all gone quiet? 
Please, pay me no mind and continue your 
chatter.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Surely you all possess confidence. —The 
confidence to call yourselves the 
strongest, leaving me aside?

text_block_list.name: Rowdy Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh, this sheer intimidation factor...! 
...Honestly, no way in hell!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... the weak have no right to claim 
it. —The title of the strongest belongs 
solely to me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell nah! The strongest—is ME!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You're pretty damn impressive, ain't ya. 
Then let's throw down right now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Aren't you going to run away like 
the rest?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ain't got no reason to. You fine with 
this, though?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
For an ojou-sama sitting on a high horse, 
I might be a bit too intense to swallow.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey. Let's settle who's on top right here, 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list:
(Not good, at this rate a fight's gonna 
break out...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...No. I shall decline.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Chickening out?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I do not engage in petty brawls outside 
the arena. It is simply a waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Rising to the summit through legitimate 
means is precisely what compels everyone 
to bow before me.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, whatever. Boring.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it didn't turn into a fight...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, whatever. Boring.
choice_data_list: I'm glad it didn't turn into a fight...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: A brawl, you say? How utterly vulgar...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Did you just look down on me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is how you felt, then perhaps that 
is your answer.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, alright, fine then. Let's do this 
right now.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: All right, that's enough!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Both of you have cleared 
Stage 1!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In Stage 1, we were secretly evaluating 
the first part of "Spirit, Technique, and 
Legs"... the strength of your "Spirit"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
An unyielding determination where neither 
backed down an inch... that is truly what 
it means to be the strongest! Both of you 
advance to the next stage!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...What the hell. So we ain't even gonna 
scrap?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whatever, I'm done here. Gonna go eat a 
parfait.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, how disappointing. Though... that was 
rather fine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It appears there are some girls here with 
real backbone. This tournament might prove 
quite enjoyable—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Though I must say, 
your praise is entirely misguided.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
When one is the strongest, there is no 
reason to ever waver.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, you're wrong. *Because* you're the 
strongest, you can't let anyone look down 
on you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If someone picks a fight, you take 'em 
down. If someone's above you, you climb 
past 'em. That's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I see. It seems you are qualified 
as well. Wouldn't you agree, Tazuna-san?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! Yes, both of you have 
cleared Stage 1!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In Stage 1, we were secretly evaluating 
the first part of "Spirit, Technique, and 
Legs"... the strength of your "Spirit"!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That unwavering heart that firmly believes 
in its own strength... that is truly what 
it means to be the strongest! Both of you 
advance to the next stage!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Makes no sense. We didn't even fight.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, whatever, I'm done here. Gonna go 
grab a parfait.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, how disappointing. Though... that was 
rather fine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It appears there are some girls here with 
real backbone. This tournament might prove 
quite enjoyable—
